name: agentcookie-e498e93b-blind30-ots
instr:
# agentcookie behaves wrongly across every command — diagnose without a test suite

I use this tool to lift a browser's saved sign-in state off one machine and hand it to the programs and agents that need it elsewhere. After picking up the current build I spent a day driving it the way I normally do, and nearly every path I touched came back wrong in some small, specific way. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits.

Standing it up on a fresh machine went badly before I had even reached the interesting parts. Collapsing duplicate copies of the browser's protected entry down to a single one is broken in both directions that matter: with three copies present and unlocking succeeding, nothing is removed and the routine gives up with an error, and with two copies whose value cannot be read it still declines to delete but the explanation no longer mentions the destruction risk; one copy, zero copies and a failure to count are all still treated as no-ops. Applying the primary setup path with the extra encryption option switched on reports a failure even though nothing it invoked actually failed. Switching on the background refresh integration for the external terminal tool aborts with an error even when the pre-flight check on the credential store passes, so the socket control mode is never set to allow-all and the background agent with its watch argument is never installed. Asking for a fresh unique name under a caller-supplied opening string returns an error ev
